title: CRITICAL: real Flash 8 FLA import — extract actual document content (0107 was a stub)
description:
Audit finding: task 0107 'real FLA import' is marked done but packages/core/src/fla/ole.ts parseFlash8Stream() only pattern-scans for stage dimensions/fps/background color and returns a SKELETON document (one empty layer) — no shapes, no symbols, no timelines, no frames, no scripts are extracted. The OLE2/CFB container layer is solid (FAT chains, directory, stream extraction); the Flash 8 binary payload parsing was never built. This is an MVP pillar (FLA compatibility) and gates the golden FLA/SWF comparison harness. Scope: reverse-engineer / implement extraction of the Flash 8 'Contents' stream document structure — at minimum: stage properties, scene/timeline/layer/frame structure, shape geometry with fills/strokes, symbol definitions + library, instance placements with matrices, frame scripts (AS2 source). References: the FLA format is partially documented by community efforts (e.g. OpenFLA/libflash research); cross-check anything ambiguous against real fixtures. Acceptance: import a real Flash 8-authored .fla fixture and assert the deserialized document model contains its actual layers/shapes/symbols/scripts (not a skeleton); fixture committed under a fixtures/ dir. Be honest about unsupported corners — partial extraction with explicit warnings beats silent skeletons.

--- ORACLE MID-FLIGHT NOTE (trajectory approved; closure checklist) ---
The working-tree parser (flash8-binary.ts CPicObj deserializer + flash8-import.ts two-pass document builder + ole.ts DIFAT extension) is the right shape, and the warnOnce honesty for unimported corners (instance/button handlers) matches the mandate. Before closing, all of: (1) a REAL Flash 8-authored .fla fixture committed under fixtures/ (the ruffle clone's CS6-era .fla test assets do not count as Flash 8 goldens); (2) tests exercising the NEW parser asserting actual extracted layers/shapes/symbols/frame-scripts from that fixture — currently zero tests reference it; (3) reconcile the now-failing legacy heuristic test (core/src/fla/__tests__/ole.test.ts 'extracts plausible width=800...') — update it to the new parser's behavior, do not silently delete coverage; (4) state explicitly in the closure evidence what is NOT imported (Media N bitmap payloads, instance handlers, etc.) so 0698 and future FLA work inherit an honest capability map; (5) commit before closing. Evidence: unit-test summary + a paste of the parsed document structure (layer/symbol/script counts) for the fixture.
